meta.executedQueryString:
SELECT rental_start_time      AS time,
       gpu_type               AS metric,
       price_per_gpu::float8  AS value
FROM rental_history
WHERE rental_start_time BETWEEN '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND '2020-01-01T01:00:00Z'
  AND price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL
  AND ('All' = 'All' OR gpu_type = 'All') AND ('All' = 'All' OR tier = 'All')
ORDER BY 1
